messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a small reserved GPU capacity bump for eu-west this Wed 09:30-10:30 UTC. Also changing the autoscale policy to lower min-burst for slice-reserved pools. Need an owner for deploy, quick smoke checklist, and rollback plan.

 dave: I can own deploy. Will do canary on 10% of traffic first. ETA for rollout ~09:40 if smoke looks good.

 jen: ping @dave — can you include a canary slice that targets internal-test customers only? Also add these smoke checks: 1) endpoint p95 latency under 120ms, 2) no 5xx spike >0.5%, 3) KV cache hit rate not dropping >10%.

 dave: yep. plan: 1) create canary slice, 2) apply autoscale change to canary, 3) run smoke harness for 15m, 4) promote or rollback.

 sachin: Add one config note: set pool-label=reserved-bump and allocation.share=0.12 for canary. If we need to revert quickly: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --pool reserved-bump` and reapply previous config from git tag `reserved-2026-04-20`.

 maria: perfect. please also add a preflight that validates GPU memory usage doesn't exceed 82% on the canary nodes.

 dave: will add mem check. Quick config snippet I'll apply in deploy job:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  burst_target: 0.12
  min_burst_window_secs: 60
```

 jen: test prompts for smoke (send to canary endpoint): short-gen, longer multi-turn chat, and an embeddings batch of 32. I can run the embeddings batch once canary is up.

 dave: noted. I'll kick off canary at 09:33 so we have a buffer. tagging @sachin for config push to infra repo.

 sachin: pushing PR now: infra/allocations/reserved-bump.yaml -> https://git.redwood/infracfg/pulls/1123. CI passed.

 deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created — job-id 73821, window 2543217180-2543217780. Owner: dave. Logs will stream to /deploys/73821.

 maria: thanks team. If smoke passes at 09:55 we promote to 50% for another 20m, then full rollout by 10:20. If anything fails we run the `rollout cancel` and revert to `reserved-2026-04-20`. :thumbsup:

 dave: got it. I'll post final status here after canary smoke (or immediate if rollback).

 jen: I'll stand by for embeddings run and validate quality thresholds.

 dave: canary started 09:33 UTC — running smoke now.

 dave: smoke results at 09:48 — p95=98ms, 5xx=0.1%, KV hit stable. Promoting to 50% now. :rocket:

 maria: great. monitoring closely.

 dave: promotion to 50% done at 09:56. continuing checks.

 dave: final: full rollout completed 10:12, no regressions observed. closing out. :white_check_mark:
